findings.relation: research: finite workflow title edit, commit and storage boundary
findings.from: 节点/流程标题与重命名声明
findings.behavior: 所选NORMAL节点标题HeadReNameTextBox.Text绑定Name（TwoWay、UpdateSourceTrigger=Explicit），IsReName另TwoWay；流程标题和Group标题也声明相同提交形式。所选右键重命名项调用RenameWindowCommand，另有RenameCommand项；前者声明默认禁用，仅IsForbidden=false且IsLoadFailed=false启用。这是具体资源入口，不把所有菜单、F2或双击都当作同一路重命名。

refs.excerpt: <appUi:HeadReNameTextBox Name="itemName" Grid.Column="1" Background="#00FFFFFF" FontWeight="Bold" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center" BorderThickness="0" MaxLength="{x:Static local:DiagramItem.MaxNameLenth}" Foreground="{Color:ColorResourceBinding Col_EditProcess_Foreground}" Text="{Binding Name, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=Explicit}" IsReName="{Binding IsReName, Mode=TwoWay}" />

<MenuItem Header="{DynamicResource Lang_Rename}" Command="{Binding RenameWindowCommand}">

        <Style TargetType="{x:Type MenuItem}">

              <Setter Property="IsEnabled" Value="True" />
            </MultiDataTrigger>
          </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
      </FrameworkElement.Style>

findings.relation: research: finite workflow title edit, commit and storage boundary
findings.to: 静态显示TextBlock与可编辑PART_ContentHost切换
findings.behavior: 本地generic资源将IsHitTestVisible绑定自身IsReName；模板默认TextBlock显示Text、PART_ContentHost Hidden，IsReName=true折叠前者并显示后者。禁用态另降border透明度。这个样式解释标题显示/编辑两个视觉部分，不意味着值已写入模块或磁盘。

refs.excerpt: <Setter Property="UIElement.IsHitTestVisible" Value="{Binding IsReName, Mode=OneWay, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Mode=Self}}" />

<ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type local:HeadReNameTextBox}">
          <Border Name="border" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding Control.BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding Control.BorderThickness}" Background="{TemplateBinding Control.Background}" SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
            <Grid>
              <TextBlock Name="tb" IsHitTestVisible="False" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" Text="{TemplateBinding TextBox.Text}" Foreground="{TemplateBinding Control.Foreground}" FontSize="{TemplateBinding Control.FontSize}" FontWeight="{TemplateBinding Control.FontWeight}" FontFamily="{TemplateBinding Control.FontFamily}" />
              <ScrollViewer Name="PART_ContentHost" Visibility="Hidden" Focusable="False" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Hidden" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Hidden" />
            </Grid>
          </Border>
          <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
            <Trigger Property="local:HeadReNameTextBox.IsReName" Value="True">
              <Setter TargetName="tb" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed" />
              <Setter TargetName="PART_ContentHost" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
              <Setter TargetName="border" Property="UIElement.Opacity" Value="0.56" />
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="UIElement.IsMouseOver" Value="True">
              <Setter TargetName="border" Value="{DynamicResource TextBox.MouseOver.Border}" Property="Border.BorderBrush" />
            </Trigger>
            <Trigger Property="UIElement.IsKeyboardFocused" Value="True">

findings.to: 显式保存消费者 → SyncSaveSolution → IMVS_SaveSolution
findings.behavior: 所选保存入口调用TempVmSolution.Init，受_isSaving门和路径/密码分支控制，随后SyncSaveSolution(path,password,IntPtr.Zero,0)。SyncSaveSolution先复位错误码/等待flag，调用IMVS_SaveSolution，立即返回码非0抛错；成功时清ParamSeted、SyncWaitor.Wait，再SDKMode下检查异步错误码。标题Name setter中没有此保存调用；不能说退出编辑立即写.sol，也不能说native导出必然包含某一重命名字节。本片只连接同一SDK状态的保存消费者边界。
